translations.web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
translations.bsb: But if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
translations.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
translations.asv: Now if their fall, is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
